# Node2Mint

> One account for AI models, token API usage, and a digital marketplace.

Node2Mint provides a multi-model AI API, token packages, a digital-product marketplace, affiliate commissions, and referral rewards.

## API (OpenAI-compatible)
- [GET /v1/models - OpenAI-compatible model list](https://www.node2mint.com/v1/models)
- [POST /v1/chat/completions - OpenAI-compatible chat completions](https://www.node2mint.com/v1/chat/completions)
- [POST /v1/messages - Anthropic-compatible messages](https://www.node2mint.com/v1/messages)

Authentication uses an API key. See /docs for request examples.
